name: Overspeeding
epl: @Name('Overspeeding') select e from Event as e where e.streamId='speed-1' and e.value > 25 and confidence > 0.68

name: EngineOverheat
epl: @Name('EngineOverheat') select e from Event as e where e.streamId='engine-temp-1' and e.value > 25 and confidence > 0.75

name: LowFuel
epl: @Name('LowFuel') select e from Event as e where e.streamId='fuel-1' and e.value < 40 and confidence > 0.5

name: HighSpeedOverheat
epl: @Name('HighSpeedOverheat') select a as over, b as heat from pattern [every a=PatternRecordStream(patternName='Overspeeding' and confidence>0.5) -> b=PatternRecordStream(patternName='EngineOverheat' and confidence>0.85)]

name: CrazyEvent
epl: @Name('CrazyEvent') select a as over, b as heat from pattern [every a=PatternRecordStream(patternName='HighSpeedOverheat' and confidence>0.75) -> b=PatternRecordStream(patternName='EngineOverheat' and confidence>0.85)]
